name: sdd-dev-kit
description: Protocol Kit for Spec-Driven Development — core + multi-host adapters + stack adapters (TS, Python, React/Vite, Node GraphQL, Terraform)

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/core && npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-ts && npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-python && npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-react-vite && npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-node-graphql && npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-terraform && npm run build -w @rogeriobatista/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/core && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-shared && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-ts && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-python && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-react-vite && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-node-graphql && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/adapter-terraform && npm run test -w @rogeriobatista/cli
